ConnectSandbox.timeout: Time-to-live from the current time, in seconds; greater than 0 or -1 (permanent sandbox), and must not exceed 604800 when greater than 0.
ConnectSandbox.snapshotID: Snapshot ID to use when resuming a paused sandbox (obtainable via "List Sandbox Snapshots"); only effective for paused sandboxes.
ConnectSandbox.volumeMounts: Only effective when resuming a paused sandbox: omit to keep existing mounts; pass an empty array to clear all mounts; a non-empty array fully replaces the mount set, up to 10 entries. Returns 400 if this field is included while the sandbox is running; use the dynamic mount API to add mounts to a running sandbox.
ConnectSandbox.volumeMounts.name: Volume name, corresponding to the volume name registered via the Create Volume API; required.
ConnectSandbox.volumeMounts.path: Mount path inside the container; must be an absolute path; required.
ConnectSandbox.volumeMounts.subPath: Subdirectory under the NFS export directory; supports the {{sandboxID}} template variable.
ConnectSandbox.volumeMounts.readOnly: Whether to mount as read-only; defaults to false.
